quality_summary: ProtLingo augments a pretrained ESM2-150M backbone with centered latent N-gram memory and sparse MoE routing. The paper provides clear architectural details, training configuration, and evaluation protocols. Quantitative results on ProteinGym, FLIP, and CASP15 contact prediction, plus ablations and biological analyses, support the claims of parameter-efficient mutation-sensitive modeling and preserved structural representations. Limitations are acknowledged, including bounded gains and unvalidated sampling choices.
